mergePolicy.baselineResolution: recordRef resolves exact pinned M752 row; entryRef resolves M740 baselineCharacter by candidateCaseId; resource handle is actual fixed loader result, not a constructed object
mergePolicy.patchMerge: shallow top-level context field replacement; arrays fully replaced; null is literal and not deletion; absent preserves baseline; no implicit deletion or source mutation; fixtures explicitly update givenName/fullName when length/surname changes
mergePolicy.faultInjection: harness-only alteration of source reads or receipt after obtaining actual trusted baseline; never expose as app API
mergePolicy.trustedHandle: M751 fixed loader must create actual verified handle; string labels confer no authority
mergePolicy.saveRestore: qualification-only stage templates are NOT storage success; actual save/restore needs eligible producer receipt and receipt-validation; missing legacy runtime receipt means not-executed
